comment: Declarative media-tool distribution data. The install UNIT is the complete capability: ffmpeg (with the configured encoder/filters) AND ffprobe together. A strategy that cannot provide both is never advertised as ready. 'downloads' is intentionally empty: no curated complete (ffmpeg+ffprobe) pinned archive has been hash-verified by this repository's contract tests yet, and hashes/URLs are never invented. Users on platforms without a package-manager strategy can supply an offline bundle descriptor (gd/workbench 'user-bundle' option).

strategies.label: Install FFmpeg with Windows Package Manager
strategies.detail: winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg -e (ffmpeg + ffprobe, libx264 and libass; winget verifies signatures and hashes and installs for the current user)
strategies.license: FFmpeg and libx264 are GPL; libass is ISC. Your system installs from your selected source. GameDirector does not distribute these binaries.

strategies.label: Install FFmpeg with Homebrew
strategies.detail: brew install ffmpeg-full (ffmpeg + ffprobe with libx264 and libass; Homebrew's plain ffmpeg formula has no subtitle support)
strategies.license: FFmpeg is GPL. Your system installs it from Homebrew.

userBundle.label: Install your offline FFmpeg bundle
userBundle.detail: Install the complete ffmpeg + ffprobe unit from a local bundle descriptor JSON. Every file's SHA-256 must verify before installation into your GameDirector media folder. Incomplete or unverified bundles are rejected.
userBundle.license: You declare the source and license in the descriptor. GameDirector verifies hashes, not licensing rights.

descriptorSchema.rid: optional; if present must equal the current runtime identifier
descriptorSchema.archive: optional path (.zip/.tar.gz/.tgz) relative to the descriptor folder
descriptorSchema.archiveSha256: required when archive is present; lowercase hex

ffmpeg.path: path inside the archive, or relative to the descriptor folder

descriptorSchema.license: free text, surfaced in the receipt
descriptorSchema.source: free text, surfaced in the receipt
